references: User supplied farmer identity, native NPC framing and native bottle screenshot. Original designs generated from these references.
preparation: Mechanical alpha-bounds cropping, nearest-neighbor export and native-grid canvases. Portrait 128x160; seeds 16x16. All bottle canvases 16x64, fruit silhouette 10x60 and beer silhouette 14x60. Bottle aspect adapted for consistent native inventory geometry.

prompts.farmer: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent pixel-art NPC PORTRAIT for a game. Reference image 1 gives the farmer's identity, clothing and gentle personality. Reference image 2 gives the game's native customer portrait framing and subdued pixel style. Create an original frontal waist-up portrait of the farmer from image 1: friendly middle-aged man with weathered kind face, short salt-and-pepper beard, battered straw hat with brown band, muted olive checked shirt, patched denim overalls, brown seed satchel strap. Face and both shoulders squarely facing the viewer, eyes straight toward camera, relaxed arms mostly below the waist crop. Entire hat and both shoulders visible. Native game style like reference 2: visible crisp pixels, restrained shading, muted gray-green and dusty blue, thin dark outlines, human proportions, no smooth illustration rendering, no cartoon chibi proportions. Crop at the waist, NO legs, NO full body. Center a compact portrait silhouette with generous transparent margins. Genuine transparent alpha outside the silhouette, no backdrop, no black rectangle, no glow or drop shadow. No text or symbols floating outside the clothes.
prompts.fruit_bottles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original game INVENTORY SPRITE ATLAS containing exactly THREE finished fruit-wine bottles, in a regular three-column single-row grid, equal cell sizes, generous transparent gutters. The reference is only a visual guide to pixel-art inventory bottle style. Left: strawberry wine, slender tall dark ruby-red glass, cork stopper, small cream paper label with a tiny red strawberry and green leaf. Center: starfruit wine, slender tall golden amber-green glass, brass-gold foil neck, cream label with a tiny yellow starfruit shape. Right: ancient-fruit wine, slender tall deep blue-purple glass, dark teal foil neck, cream label with a tiny teal-blue ancient fruit and purple leaf. Three elegant slim bottles with distinct shoulder, glass and label colors, same family. Crisp hard-edged pixel art, muted detailed palette, thin dark outline, subtle one-pixel glass highlights, compatible with a gritty sci-fi pawnshop game. Readable when each bottle is reduced to 16 by 64 pixels. No lettering or readable words. Only the three bottle silhouettes may be opaque; all background, margins and gutters must be genuine alpha 0. No vignettes, cast shadows, ground, grid lines or watermark. Essential: exactly 3 separate bottles on one row, equally spaced.
prompts.beer_bottles: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one original game INVENTORY SPRITE ATLAS containing exactly TWO broad squat beer bottles, arranged in a regular two-column single-row grid with equal cell sizes and generous transparent gutters. Reference image is a style and broad-bottle shoulder guide. Left: wheat beer in a broad round-shouldered amber-brown glass bottle with short neck, metal crown cap, cream paper label bearing a tiny golden wheat stalk emblem. Right: pale ale in a broad round-shouldered dark green glass bottle with short neck, metal crown cap, cream paper label bearing a tiny green hops-cone emblem. Both have sturdy wide bodies, clearly wider and squatter than slender wine bottles, roughly 2.2 times as tall as wide, suitable for a 2x2-cell inventory item. Original crisp pixel art matching a gritty sci-fi pawnshop inventory: muted earth tones, thin dark outlines, a few glass highlight pixels, carefully readable labels at small size. No readable lettering. Only the two bottle silhouettes may be opaque; everything around and between them alpha 0. No black backdrop, glow, ground, external shadows, grid lines, text or watermarks.
